baseline_pins.rule: Prefix zero is the exact union of independently pinned A and B baseline bags/progress. R04 deltas are compared against that baseline; no prefix asserts a source-global object or edge is absent merely because no R04 slot has created it.
baseline_pins.status: required_before_schedule_freeze; exact complete bags and progress are not yet bound

baseline_preservation_rule: At every prefix preserve all baseline objects, edges, history, tombstones, values, presence states, source progress and retained publication data except exact changes explicitly admitted by completed R04 source transactions. The complete baseline bags must be independently read and pinned before freeze.
incident_edge_policy_gate: No R3 expected state may assert an incident edge was deleted, retained or tombstoned until accepted Truss semantics and the full schedule preselect one valid endpoint-closure policy before any R04 source mutation. R2 preserves the exact R1 edge identity/endpoints; R2 request freeze cannot choose this semantic.
independence: Expected state comes from accepted original source request bytes, public source commit result/readback, and source-owned committed feed/page custody. Do not derive expected values from SQL, native current rows, publisher receipts, or the system under test.
presence_and_value_rules: For every property compare `absent`, explicit `null`, and `present(value)` separately.
Preserve original JSON scalar forms and exact integers/decimals/strings as delivered by the accepted sources; do not normalize or infer them.
For R1 Person/Place required fields are present and non-null; optional quantity is absent in the draft lifecycle.
For R2 retain exact unchanged person_key, change person_name, and transition quantity from absent to a present accepted integer.
For R3 preserve prior values in history and a Person tombstone; incident-edge outcome is unresolved until one valid endpoint-closure policy is fixed in the frozen schedule before any R04 mutation.
A4/B4 values and schema revision remain unresolved until the accepted additive candidate is known.
